review_reference: The services as deployed now, after four backend releases since ef81b4f: backend-40944746728-1-af283acb04b5abf5 (D-Eminence/hid-system#134 at 61fb36b, Node 22.23.4 security fix, all twelve services), backend-40981383492-1-e81fc1538b1028ac (#131 at 8749271, ehr-api), backend-41019669602-1-4c6216ab762aaf4c (#132 at 24b976d, migration 0098, identity-api and ehr-api) and backend-41025269743-1-c5c90b301b8da2d9 (#135 at f2d2d55, migration 0099, ehr-api). So identity-api pins to 24b976d, ehr-api to f2d2d55 and every other service to 61fb36b. Browser-facing changes since the previous pins: new EHR offline routes (ping, receipt lookup, audit ingest, escrow key; this frontend does not call them yet) and the sealed demo tenant's guards in identity-api (demo facilities refuse sharing with real ones). Nothing this frontend calls changed shape. Reviewed and approved by the repository owner, D-Eminence, in chat on 2026-10-30 ("Approve", in reply to the request to re-pin the website so the blue EHR can release).
